newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland may sell PBK bank stake in late May - HSBC.
newsitem.headline: Poland may sell PBK bank stake in late May - HSBC.

text.p: The Polish Finance Ministry is likely to sell to an investor up to 65 percent of Polski Bank Kredytowy SA (PBK) in late May, an official from the ministry's adviser to the sale, HSBC Investment Services, said.
"I expect the results of the (PBK sale) tender in late May because...the ministry wants to sign the agreement at that time," HSBC's Hubert Janiszewski told Reuters on Wednesday.

In January the finance ministry invited bids for no less than 10 percent and no more than 65 percent of PBK and said that it expected to finish negotiations with shortlisted investors at the end of April.
Janiszewski said the initial public offer for PBK, in which another 15 percent of the bank is expected to be sold, was likely to take place as scheduled in October.
HSBC has estimated the total value of PBK at between 1.2 and 1.6 billion zlotys.
